Info

Defines structural protocol IQueryController for robot hardware status and position queries.

class scarajectory.core.service.manipulator.iquery_controller.IQueryController(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining hardware telemetry and state query operations.

It defines:

methods:
